entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Player Companion: People of the River
entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can use an opponent as a springboard.

Prerequisite(s) Acrobatics 3 ranks.

Benefit(s) When you spend a swift action to attempt a performance combat check after a successful charge attack or combat maneuver, you gain a +2 bonus on your performance combat check and gain a +4 bonus on your next Acrobatics, Climb, Fly, Ride, or Swim check attempted before the end of your next turn.
